authorizationBasis: Routine pre-judgment source-exactness and independently recomputed capacity correction under the current single-debate runbook; the failed candidate has not been accepted or judged.

outputShape.moves: one per original move in original order: moveId,startEvent,endEvent,quoteEligibleExactSpans,evidenceRationale (80+ chars),longerCompleteArgumentRationale (empty unless necessary, 100+ chars for >2200),attributionConfidence (may lower, never raise),attributionRationale (40+ chars)

rules: Read the complete indexed source, baseline semantic inventory, original packet and correction helper visibly before drafting; other debates, external research, scores and tags are forbidden.

Preserve every selected move ID, speaker, side, claim, reason, inference, importance, burden link, response link, section assignment, section weight and material-wording confidence. Do not add, delete, merge, split or reinterpret moves. If evidence cannot support the original semantic fields inside the frozen scope, report that substantive blocker instead of forcing a correction.

Repair minimal exact span endpoints and quotations, including all known non-exact quotes and all intersecting boundaries. The first attempt selected event 1188 into an exclusion and began the religion card at excluded event 1234; no corrected span may overlap any frozen excluded interval. Do not change those exclusion intervals.

Audit quotation ownership in mixed speech; a Dawkins card must not quote Chopra as though the words were his, and a quoted passage read by Dawkins from Chopra should not be mistaken for his own assertion. Prefer a clear owned challenge over a quotation of an opponent.

Keep spans to the smallest complete passage that supports the existing claim and load-bearing reason; do not retain whole turns merely for context. Source context is already available in full. If a coherent combined move genuinely requires >2200 characters, explain the specific necessity.

Count tables will be rebuilt by the controller. Give a source-led rationale for the existing four con cards in consciousness-and-emergence and the balanced four-row transcendence section; other sections remain unchanged. Do not manufacture symmetry.

Only create the declared correction output once via apply_patch. No scripts, other outputs, external calls, credentials, or overwriting. Before the single final submission validate your draft in memory by piping JSON to node tmp-current-inventory-correction.mjs --check-stdin PACKET. This read-only helper checks every scope, quote, count and semantic-preservation constraint without any score calculation.
Use env -u OPENAI_API_KEY -u ANTHROPIC_API_KEY for shell commands. All subscription-backed work has zero direct incremental cost.
